meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

howto.what: Claude 会讲解 claude-mem 的机制:每次读取、编辑、执行 Bash 都会生成压缩观察,会话结束时汇总;相关观察会自动注入后续对话,让下个会话带上上次的上下文,并说明数据保存在本机 ~/.claude-mem。
howto.when: 当用户问“claude-mem 是怎么工作的?”或“这个东西在做什么?”时触发;它也会说明记忆注入从项目的第二次会话开始。

say.note: 它会讲解观察记录的采集与注入流程。
它会说明数据保存在本机 ~/.claude-mem。

say.text: 记忆从第几次会话开始注入?
say.note: 它会告诉你是从第二次会话开始。

howto.what_en: Claude explains how claude-mem works: every Read, Edit, and Bash becomes a compressed observation; observations are summarized at session end; relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts; data stays in ~/.claude-mem on this machine.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks “how does claude-mem work?” or “what is this thing doing?”. It also explains that memory injection starts from the second session in a project.

say_en.note: Explains how observations are captured and injected.
Data lives in ~/.claude-mem on this machine.

say_en.text: From which session does injection start?
